title: COPA: A Congestion-Oriented Pin Assignment Framework for Intra-Block Physical Design Optimization
problem: Hierarchical IC pin assignment focuses on wirelength minimization but overlooks impact on internal routing congestion and feedthrough pin placement.
method: Congestion-oriented gradient-based optimization framework iteratively adjusting feedthrough pin positions based on routing-demand-driven congestion metrics.
key_novelty: First framework explicitly targeting feedthrough pin assignment to minimize routing congestion within hierarchical designs.
contributions: Formulation of feedthrough pin assignment as nonlinear optimization
7.6% average routing overflow reduction without wirelength increase
primary_theme: Congestion-aware pin assignment for hierarchical physical design
